pairs: Eliseus autem prophetes vocavit unum de filiis prophetarum,
Now the prophet Elisha called one of the sons of the prophets,
et tolle lenticulam olei hanc in manu tua,
and take this little bottle of oil in your hand,
And when you arrive in that place,
videbis Jehu filium Josaphat filii Namsi:
you will see Jehu, the son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi.
et ingressus suscitabis eum de medio fratrum suorum,
And upon entering, you shall raise him up from the midst of his brothers,
and you shall lead him into an inner room.
And taking the little bottle of oil,
you shall pour it upon his head,
I have anointed you as king over Israel.’
And you shall open the door
And you shall not remain in that place.”
Abiit ergo adolescens puer prophetæ in Ramoth Galaad,
Therefore, the young man, a servant of the prophet, went away to Ramoth Gilead.
and behold, the leaders of the army were sitting there,
Et surrexit, et ingressus est cubiculum:
And he rose up and entered into the room.
at ille fudit oleum super caput ejus,
And he poured the oil on his head, and he said:
et ait: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël:
“Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel:
Unxi te regem super populum Domini Israël,
‘I have anointed you as king over Israel, the people of the Lord.
et percuties domum Achab domini tui,
And you shall strike down the house of Ahab,
et ulciscar sanguinem servorum meorum prophetarum,
your lord. And I will avenge the blood of my servants, the prophets,
et sanguinem omnium servorum Domini de manu Jezabel.
and the blood of all the servants of the Lord, from the hand of Jezebel.
And I will destroy the entire house of Ahab.
et interficiam de Achab mingentem ad parietem,
And I will cause to pass away from Ahab, whatever urinates against a wall,
et clausum et novissimum in Israël.
and whatever is lame, and whatever is least in Israel.
Et dabo domum Achab sicut domum Jeroboam filii Nabat,
And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat,
et sicut domum Baasa filii Ahia.
and like the house of Baasha, the son of Ahijah.
Jezabel quoque comedent canes in agro Jezrahel,
Also, the dogs will consume Jezebel, in the field of Jezreel.
Neither will there be anyone who may bury her.’”
And then he opened the door,
Jehu autem egressus est ad servos domini sui:
Then Jehu went out to the servants of his lord.
quid venit insanus iste ad te?
Why has this insane man come to you?”
“He said to me these certain things,
I have anointed you as king over Israel.’”
And so they hurried away. And each one,
et unusquisque tollens pallium suum posuerunt sub pedibus ejus in similitudinem tribunalis,
taking his cloak, placed it under his feet, in the manner of a seat for judgment.
Conjuravit ergo Jehu filius Josaphat filii Namsi contra Joram:
Then Jehu, the son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi,
conspired against Joram. Now Joram had besieged Ramoth Gilead,
ipse et omnis Israël contra Hazaël regem Syriæ:
he and all of Israel, against Hazael, the king of Syria.
et reversus fuerat ut curaretur in Jezrahel propter vulnera,
And he had returned, so that he might be cured at Jezreel, because of his wounds.
quia percusserant eum Syri præliantem contra Hazaël regem Syriæ.
For the Syrians had struck him, while he was fighting against Hazael, the king of Syria.
let no one depart, fleeing from the city;
ne vadat, et nuntiet in Jezrahel.
otherwise he may go and give a report in Jezreel.”
Et ascendit, et profectus est in Jezrahel:
And he climbed up and set out for Jezreel,
et Ochozias rex Juda descenderat ad visitandum Joram.
and Ahaziah, the king of Judah, had gone down to visit Joram.
Igitur speculator qui stabat super turrim Jezrahel,
And so the watchman, who was standing upon the tower of Jezreel,
saw the crowd of Jehu arriving,
and he said, “I see a crowd.”
et mitte in occursum eorum, et dicat vadens:
and send to meet them. And those who go should say,
he who had climbed into the chariot went away to meet him,
Also the watchman gave a report,
And then he sent a second chariot of horses.
Then the watchman gave a report,
“He went all the way to them,
est autem incessus quasi incessus Jehu filii Namsi,
But their advance is like the advance of Jehu, the son of Nimshi.
et egressus est Joram rex Israël,
And Joram, the king of Israel, and Ahaziah,
And they went out to meet Jehu.
et invenerunt eum in agro Naboth Jezrahelitæ.
And they met him in the field of Naboth, the Jezreelite.
And when Joram had seen Jehu, he said,
For still the fornications of your mother, Jezebel,
and her many poisons, are thriving.”
Then Joram turned his hand, and,
But Jehu bent his bow with his hand,
and he struck Joram between the shoulders.
et egressa est sagitta per cor ejus,
And the arrow went through his heart,
and immediately he fell in his chariot.
And Jehu said to Bidkar, his commander:
Tolle, projice eum in agro Naboth Jezrahelitæ:
“Take and cast him into the field of Naboth, the Jezreelite.
memini enim quando ego et tu sedentes in curru sequebamur Achab patrem hujus,
For I remember, when you and I, sitting in a chariot,
quod Dominus onus hoc levaverit super eum,
were following Ahab, this man’s father, that the Lord lifted this burden upon him,
‘Certainly, I will repay you in this field,
says the Lord, for the blood of Naboth,
and for the blood of his sons,
et projice eum in agrum juxta verbum Domini.
and cast him into the field, in accord with the word of the Lord.”
Ochozias autem rex Juda videns hoc,
But Ahaziah, the king of Judah, seeing this,
fled along the way of the garden house.
persecutusque est eum Jehu, et ait:
And Jehu pursued him, and he said,
Etiam hunc percutite in curru suo.
“Strike this one also in his chariot.”
Et percusserunt eum in ascensu Gaver,
And they struck him on the ascent to Gur,
Et imposuerunt eum servi ejus super currum suum,
And his servants placed him upon his chariot,
and they took him to Jerusalem.
sepelieruntque eum in sepulchro cum patribus suis in civitate David.
And they buried him in the sepulcher with his fathers, in the city of David.
In the eleventh year of Joram,
the son of Ahab, Ahaziah reigned over Judah.
And she watched through a window,
as Jehu was entering through the gate.
“Is it possible for there to be peace for Zimri,
Levavitque Jehu faciem suam ad fenestram,
And Jehu lifted up his face to the window,
et inclinaverunt se ad eum duo vel tres eunuchi.
And two or three eunuchs bowed down before him.
and the wall was splattered with her blood,
and the hoofs of the horses trampled her.
Cumque introgressus esset ut comederet biberetque,
And when he had entered, so that he might eat and drink,
“Go, and see to that cursed woman,
et sepelite eam: quia filia regis est.
and bury her. For she is the daughter of a king.”
But when they had gone, so that they might bury her,
they found nothing but the skull,
and the ends of her hands.
And returning, they reported to him.

quem locutus est per servum suum Eliam Thesbiten,
which he spoke through his servant, Elijah the Tishbite, saying:
dicens: In agro Jezrahel comedent canes carnes Jezabel,

et erunt carnes Jezabel sicut stercus super faciem terræ in agro Jezrahel,
